create_roberta_config_with_soft_pet: create a RobertaConfig instance with soft_pet enabled for pattern-exploiting training
create_roberta_config_with_prompt_tuning: create a RobertaConfig instance with prompt_tune enabled and custom prompt_length
create_roberta_config_with_prototypical_: create a RobertaConfig instance with prototypical_similarity set to cosine or euclidean
create_roberta_config_with_token_hinge_l: create a RobertaConfig instance with token_hinge_loss enabled for token-level loss
create_roberta_config_with_multiclass_ce: create a RobertaConfig instance with multiclass_ce_loss enabled for multiclass classification
